versionStatus: REVIEW_CANDIDATE_NOT_ACTIVATED — 1.11.0 is the Phase 5D capability candidate (R1.16 — controlled entity aliases → durable story mentions): news drafts on the NEW draft path are now durably connected to their REGISTERED entities through the controlled alias catalog. Policy `em1` (versioned, bounded, explicit): normalization stays NFC + whitespace-collapse + trim ONLY (no case folding, no ی/ک or digit conversion — matching is byte-exact under the registered forms); candidate phrases are byte-exact 1..4-token windows between Unicode word boundaries (letters/numbers/marks; ZWNJ U+200C is word-INTERNAL — a conscious نیم‌فاصله decision) generated width-major from the item's OWN full composed text; ONE parameterized indexed IN-list lookup (≤90 phrases ≤ the D1 per-query bound-parameter limit) with ORDER BY before LIMIT 91 (90+overflow probe) against idx_entity_alias_lookup — no full-table scan, no per-word unbounded queries, no SQL interpolation. A normalized_alias mapping to EXACTLY ONE entity resolves that entity; a shared alias (≥2 owners) is AMBIGUOUS with ZERO auto links (no first-row-wins, no invented confidence threshold); result overflow embeds NOTHING (zero links, honest lookup_overflow); phrase/token caps are recorded when hit (bounded_scan_window — no full-coverage claim). For every unique resolution the SAME fenced atomic commit writes ONE `story_entities` row (relation `mentioned`, confidence 0) whose SQL predicate re-checks INSIDE the batch that the alias STILL maps to exactly that entity — a mapping deleted, remapped, or given a second owner between lookup and commit no-ops ONLY that link (never an invalid link, never a partial editorial state, never a forced AI re-run). The versioned `entityMentions` report (mentionsVersion 1, policyVersion em1) travels inside document_json of the SAME commit with the snapshot identity, observations (no_phrases/no_match/mentions/ambiguous_only/lookup_overflow), matched/ambiguous lists, scan flags, caps and fixed limitations; the typed reader separates entity_mentions_v1 / absent / unsupported_version / malformed and validates real builder invariants (count/order/identity). Mention resolution runs strictly AFTER the input gates and the early-reuse decisions — replayed/reused snapshots never run lookups and historical/reused drafts are NEVER enriched or backfilled (reuse_drafts_not_enriched; the accepted R1.15.2 exact-content reuse contract is preserved byte-for-byte). News text NEVER adds entities/aliases to the catalog; an empty catalog and a zero-row lookup are the same honest no_match_observed (never a proof of absence). NOT ACTIVATED anywhere; no deploy and no live-variable change performed.
